name: Supermarket Cola Dash Deluxe!
storyline: Camer the Dragon wants cola and the supermarket is having an extremely good cola sale! He also likes bananas and they're on the same sale too! He's so excited that he puts anything in his trolley that he comes across, but if he puts too much other stuff in his trolley he must stop and only take the cola he got to that point. Lily the Dragon is also excited about the sale, because she wants lemonade and they're having the sale on lemonade too. She also likes bananas and will act the same as Camer the Dragon during the sale.
summary: A 3D endless runner style game utilising sprites featuring Camer the Dragon and Lily the Dragon.
